packages.title: Calendar: room for today's tasks at large text, and three small fixes
brief: UX-202 (S3; partly fixed, failed once). What round 1 did (P6), all verified and to keep: the `Tu calendario` row and sync button are gone; the scope chip hides with no project (project_scope_control.dart:26-28); the ring is gone; `Bandeja · N` shows only when N > 0, under the tasks; one `Semana ▾` menu (key `calendar-format`) offers Semana/Mes/Día; `Hoy` shows only on another day.

Why it failed: ux-tester's render App/build/calendar-es-1.3x-light.png (Spanish, 390×844, 1.3× text, 24 dp top and bottom view padding, design sample tasks) has the second task's bottom at y=639 while TaskActions starts at y=590, so about 49 dp are missing. Two causes: the month line wraps (`octubre de 2026` on one line, `Semana ▾` on the next, about 30 dp; it also leaves the chevrons floating between the two lines), and TaskActions stacks `Dictar una tarea` over `Nueva tarea` because 14 × 1.3 > 18 (task_actions.dart:52-53, about 60 dp).
Subtract, in calendar_screen.dart (about 52 dp in total):

1. Month line (around :325-333, the `DateFormat.yMMMM(context.localeName).format(_focusedDay)` Text inside the Wrap): when `_focusedDay.year` is the current year (use the clock the screen already uses, `_now()`), show only the month with `DateFormat.LLLL(context.localeName)`: ES `octubre`, CA `octubre`, EN `October`. For any other year keep `DateFormat.yMMMM` (`octubre de 2027`). Use LLLL, not MMMM: intl's Catalan format months carry the preposition (`d’octubre`, `de gener`); LLLL uses the standalone names. Keep the Wrap, so at 2× text on 320 dp the switcher and `Hoy` still wrap rather than overflow.
2. The `Agenda de hoy` / weekday heading (around :521, `EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 26, 24, 12)`): top padding 26 → 12.

3. The ProjectScopeControl sliver (around :276-281, `Padding(EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 0, 24, 8), child: ProjectScopeControl())`): the 8 dp stays even when the control draws nothing. In project_scope_control.dart, when the Wrap would have no children (no scope chip and no `Para mí` / `Equipo` chips), return `const SizedBox.shrink()`; give ProjectScopeControl an optional `padding` (default zero) that it applies only when it draws something, and have Calendar pass `EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 0, 24, 8)` instead of wrapping it. Leave home_screen.dart's use as it is.

Don't touch TaskActions: P38 (later in this run) replaces its two buttons with one `Añadir tarea`, which frees the stacked row (about 60 dp). If the 1.3× render still shows the second task under the bar after steps 1-3, don't tune other paddings; write the measured y values in your notes.

UX-446 (S1; regression R1B-4 from P6): the `calendar-format` PopupMenuButton has no tooltip, so TalkBack reads Material's `Mostrar menú`. Add `tooltip: context.l10n.changeView` with a new key `changeView`: EN `Change view` / ES `Cambiar vista` / CA `Canvia la vista`.

UX-442 (S2; regression R1B-2 from P6): the events read-error line says `Actualiza para volver a intentarlo…` but its tap opens calendar choice. In device_calendar_events.dart: (a) `if (state.error)` (:35) currently taps `choose` (/deviceCalendars): make it call `ref.read(deviceCalendarProvider.notifier).refresh()`; (b) the per-day load error (:49) currently opens the sheet, which shows the same error again: make it retry the day with `ref.invalidate(deviceEventsProvider(Task.dateKey(day)))`. The access prompts (`calendarDenied`, `calendarNoSelection`) keep opening /deviceCalendars. Both read-error lines use a new key `calendarReadRetry`: EN `Couldn’t read your events. Tap to try again.` / ES `No se pudieron leer los eventos. Toca para reintentar.` / CA `No s’han pogut llegir els esdeveniments. Toca per tornar-ho a provar.` Keep `calendarReadError` as it is: the day timeline (day_timeline_screen.dart:124), the device-calendars screen (device_calendars_screen.dart:76) and the sheet (device_calendar_events.dart:162) still use it in places with no tap.

UX-445 (S1; regression R1B-3 from P7): one tile reads `vie, 16 oct · 17:00` and `12 oct · Fecha límite vencida`. In task_planning_control.dart:7-13, `taskDeadlineLabel` uses `context.shortDate(date)`; use `context.weekdayDate(date)` instead (UX-111's format, ES `dom, 12 de oct`). The reviewer suggested `dayLabel`, but `deadlineLabel` puts the date inside a sentence (`Vence {date}`, `Due {date}`, `Termini: {date}`), and dayLabel's standalone `Hoy` / `Mañana` would read `Vence Hoy`. The time part (`· 17:00`) stays. This also changes the deadline on the detail, the form and the capture review, which all call taskDeadlineLabel; that is intended.
Don't touch: TaskActions (P38), the header icons (P25), the empty-state text, the overdue section, the landing highlight (P7), the reminders sheet (P55).
acceptance: Render/Widget test (existing, calendar_feedback_test.dart `UX-202: at 1.3x text in Spanish…`, light and dark): in Spanish at 390×844 with 1.3× text and 24 dp view padding, the first two tasks' bottoms are above TaskActions' top, with no scrolling. The 1.0× renders still pass.

Widget test: in Spanish at 1.3× text on 390×844, on the current month, the month line reads `octubre` (no year) and the `Semana` switcher is on the same line (their vertical centres within 4 dp). A month in another year shows its yMMMM form, e.g. `octubre de 2027`.
Widget test: in Catalan the month line for the current month reads `octubre`, never `d’octubre`.
Widget test: on Calendar with no projects, ProjectScopeControl takes 0 height.
Widget test: the `calendar-format` button's tooltip (TalkBack label) is `Cambiar vista` in Spanish, `Change view` in English, `Canvia la vista` in Catalan.

Widget test: phone calendar enabled and granted with a calendar selected, and the day's events failing: the line reads `No se pudieron leer los eventos. Toca para reintentar.`; tapping it fetches the events again (the fake is called a second time), opens no sheet and pushes no /deviceCalendars route. With `state.error` true, tapping the line calls the notifier's refresh.

Widget test: in Spanish, today Mon 13 Oct 2026, a task scheduled Fri 16 Oct 17:00 with a deadline of Sun 12 Oct shows the deadline as `Vence <weekdayDate(12 Oct)> · Fecha límite vencida` (compute the date with `context.weekdayDate`), never `Vence 12 oct`.
deviceChecks: Spanish, 1.3× text, a 390×844 phone, two tasks today: open the app; both tasks are fully visible above the buttons without scrolling.
TalkBack on Calendar: the view switcher is read as `Cambiar vista`, not `Mostrar menú`.

packages.title: Tareas heading never overflows; shared projects look shared in the picker
brief: UX-308 (S3; partly fixed, failed once). What round 1 did (P12), verified by the reviewer and to keep: the folder icon became `TextButton(Text(l10n.lists))` (Projects / Proyectos / Projectes) at home_screen.dart:93-98; the picker's `Nuevo proyecto` row; the sheet title `Proyecto` with no subtitle.

Why it failed: ux-tester's `UX-308: at 2x text on a 320 dp phone the Proyectos button fits beside the heading (es/ca/en)` throws `A RenderFlex overflowed by 45 pixels` (es, ca) and 17 px (en): the `Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min)` at home_screen.dart:90, inside the heading's Wrap, can't wrap. The reviewer showed the size is a test-font artifact: home_screen_test.dart doesn't load Manrope, so every glyph is 1 em wide (`Proyectos` ≈ 252 dp). With Manrope w700 at 28 px the labels are 143 dp (es), 136 (ca), 119 (en), and the pair is about 199 dp of the 272 dp available. Both reports are right: the test measured the wrong font, and a Row that can't wrap would still overflow in a longer label or at a larger text size.

1. App: in home_screen.dart replace that inner `Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [TextButton…, IconButton…])` with `Wrap(crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center, children: [...])`, same children. A Wrap shrinks to its content, so the pair stays together at the end of the heading when it fits, and the icon drops under the label instead of overflowing. Don't put the buttons straight into the outer Wrap: its `spaceBetween` would put `Proyectos` in the middle of the line.

2. Test harness: in App/test/home_screen_test.dart add a `setUpAll` that loads the real fonts exactly as App/test/calendar_feedback_test.dart:42-49 does (`FontLoader('Manrope')..addFont(rootBundle.load('assets/fonts/Manrope.ttf'))` and `FontLoader('MaterialIcons')..addFont(rootBundle.load('fonts/MaterialIcons-Regular.otf'))`, plus the `rootBundle` import). Don't change any test's assertions.

UX-443 (S2; regression R1C-1 from P12): in the project sheet, task_list_picker.dart:64-68 gives a shared row a subtitle only when it has a group name, so a project shared person by person (`groupId == null`) looks exactly like a private one, on the capture review and on new tasks where no share dialog appears. Make the subtitle of every shared row `list.groupName ?? context.l10n.sharedProject`, with a new key `sharedProject`: EN `Shared` / ES `Compartido` / CA `Compartit`. Not the people's names: `list.people` includes the user, and the audience line under the chip already names who sees it after the choice. Archived rows keep `Archivado`.
Don't touch: the share dialog and the locked chip (UX-302, verified), the `Sí` / `¿Es correcto?` line (UX-325), the editTaskList dialog.
acceptance: Widget test (home_screen_test.dart, with Manrope and MaterialIcons loaded via FontLoader): at 320×640 with 2× text, in Spanish, Catalan and English, the Tareas heading reports no overflow, and `Proyectos` / `Projectes` / `Projects` and the completed-tasks button are hit-testable; tapping them opens /lists and /completedTasks.
Widget test: at 390×844 with 1× text in Spanish, `Proyectos` and the completed-tasks button sit on the same line.

Widget test: the project sheet in Spanish shows a project shared person by person (shared, no group) with the subtitle `Compartido`, a group project with its group name, and a personal project with no subtitle. In English the first reads `Shared`, in Catalan `Compartit`.

packages.title: Capture sheet: Seguir only after a pause; honest TalkBack; shorter hint
brief: All three are regressions from P35 in App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart. Everything else P35 did was verified; keep it.

UX-440 (S2): `Seguir` shows on shared and resumed text that was never listening. `canContinue` (around :1017-1022) uses `resting`, which is `idle || paused`. A WhatsApp share, or a typed capture reopened from `Capturas pendientes`, opens idle with text, so it shows a grey mic, `Seguir` and `Listo`, with no status line (`idle` maps to null at :1003); `Seguir` starts the mic when the person only wanted to go on. Make `canContinue` require `phase == _CapturePhase.paused`, or `phase == _CapturePhase.idle && _session?.source == 'speech'` (a resumed voice capture); keep its other conditions (`!_typing`, `!recorded`, `_nativeMode`, words not empty). Typed and shared text then shows only `Listo`, `Cancelar` and the keyboard button.

UX-441 (S2): `_stopRecording` (around :722-733) announces `l10n.done` (`Listo` / `Done` / `Fet`) on every stop, so a TalkBack user who taps Cancelar hears `Listo`, the name of the send button. Announce by reason: `done` only when `submit` is true; `capturePaused` (EN `Paused` / ES `En pausa` / CA `En pausa`, existing key) when the stop is an interruption the user didn't ask for (leaving the app :780, audio focus :713, the recognizer ending :505, the start-up races :613/:653/:658, `_interruptCapture` :938); nothing for Cancelar (:872, the keep-or-discard dialog takes focus) or Escribir (:858, focus moves to the field). Cancel passes `interrupted: true` to land in `paused`; keep that phase, and add a way to stop without announcing (for example a `quiet` flag on `_finishRecording`, passed by `_cancel` and `_typeInstead`).

UX-444 (S1): the silence hint (around :1125-1136, `maxLines: 2`, ellipsis) is cut in English at 2× text: `Still listening — tap Done when you’re finished.` needs 3 lines across 312 dp (reviewer's Manrope width model; ES and CA fit). Shorten app_en.arb `captureStillListening` to `Still listening. Tap Done when finished.` Keep `maxLines: 2` (the comment above it says why). ES and CA are unchanged.
Don't touch: the sheet layout, the Cancel dialog copy, the 60 s cap, P3's speech hints and session source.
acceptance: Widget test: in Spanish, a shared-text entry opened in the capture sheet with `startListening: false` shows `Listo` and `Cancelar` and no `Seguir`.

Widget test: a voice capture interrupted while listening (app goes to background) shows `En pausa` and `Seguir`; a resumed voice capture (session source `speech`, idle, with words) also shows `Seguir`.

Widget test (extends the UX-109 test): with words heard, tapping `Cancelar` produces no `Listo` announcement; tapping `Listo` produces exactly one; tapping the keyboard button produces none; the app going to background while listening announces `En pausa`.
Widget test: in English at 2× text on 360×740, after 5 s of silence the hint reads `Still listening. Tap Done when finished.` in full (not truncated).
deviceChecks: TalkBack on a phone: Cancelar with words says nothing before the keep-or-discard question; Listo says `Listo`.

packages.title: The reminders question waits until the save message is gone
brief: UX-439 (S2; regression from P51, raised by reviewers B and D). P51's sheet (reminder_ask_sheet.dart) is verified; keep its copy, its once-per-account rule and `turnOnReminders`. The problem is timing: `_ask` waits only for the form's route (`await route.completed`, :44) and opens the sheet about 300 ms after the form closes. The 4 s save message `Añadida al {weekdayDate}` with `Deshacer` (task_editor.dart:393-417) and the 1.5 s landing highlight (calendar_screen.dart:110-154) then play out under the sheet's scrim, so on the newcomer's first dated task they never see where it went, and Undo is gone when the sheet closes.

1. `showFeedback` (App/lib/widgets/app_components.dart:10) already returns `Future<ScaffoldFeatureController<SnackBar, SnackBarClosedReason>?>`; no change there. Give `askAboutRemindersAfterSave` an optional named `feedback` parameter of that type. In task_editor.dart (around :400-418) and review_tasks_screen.dart (around :157 and :222-224), keep the showFeedback future in a variable, `unawaited` it as now, and pass it as `feedback:`.

2. In `askAboutRemindersAfterSave` / `_ask`: at the call (the form's route has just been popped), remember the route now on top of the navigator, the one the form was over (for example `navigator.popUntil((r) { under = r; return true; })`, which pops nothing). After `await route.completed`, also await the feedback controller's `closed`. Then: if it closed with `SnackBarClosedReason.action` (the person tapped Deshacer), don't ask; if `under` is no longer current (they opened Nueva tarea, a task, or another screen), don't ask. In both cases remove the owner from `_askingProvider` (the existing `finally` with `shown == false` does this), so the next dated save asks. Otherwise show the sheet as now.
3. Update the doc comment on `askAboutRemindersAfterSave` to say it waits for the save message to close.

How this fits with later packages: P36-P38 move saves into the capture sheet; P51's note already says the new sheet must call `askAboutRemindersAfterSave` after it closes; it should now also pass its confirmation's controller as `feedback`.
Don't touch: the sheet's copy and layout, `turnOnReminders`, FeedbackTimeout (with Android's `Time to take action` set longer, the question simply comes later).
acceptance: Widget test (reminder_ask_sheet_test.dart): new account, reminders off, never asked, Spanish. Save a dated task from Calendar's `Nueva tarea`: right after the form closes, the save message (`Añadida al …`, compute the date with `context.weekdayDate`) and `Deshacer` are visible and hit-testable, the new row is highlighted, and there is no BottomSheet. After the message's timeout, the sheet with `Sí, recuérdamelo` and `Ahora no` appears.
Widget test: tapping `Deshacer` on that message shows no sheet; the next dated save shows it after its own message closes.
Widget test: opening `Nueva tarea` (or a task) before the message closes never shows the sheet over that screen; the next dated save asks.
Widget test: the voice review saving its last draft with a date shows the save message first, and the sheet only after it closes.
The existing 2× text, 320×568 tests in reminder_ask_sheet_test.dart (es, ca) still pass.
deviceChecks: Fresh account on a phone, first dated task: the row lights up and `Deshacer` can be tapped before the question appears; TalkBack reads the question once.
